home.title: Middle Monitor — Unified Observability for Your Whole Stack
home.description: The unified observability platform that correlates traces, metrics, logs and errors so you find the root cause in seconds, not hours. OpenTelemetry-native.

pricing.title: Pricing — Middle Monitor Observability Platform
pricing.description: Simple, transparent observability pricing. Every new organization starts with a 14-day Pro trial, no credit card. Then stay free with 1 host, or go Pro for 10 hosts, profiling, alerting and root cause analysis.

docs.title: Documentation — Middle Monitor
docs.description: Middle Monitor docs: install the agent and SDKs (Go, Node.js, Python, Rust), instrument traces, metrics, logs and errors, and set up alerting and the API.

contact.title: Contact Us — Middle Monitor
contact.description: Get in touch with the Middle Monitor team: questions about the observability platform, pricing, onboarding or support. We respond as soon as possible.

status.title: Status Page — Middle Monitor
status.description: Middle Monitor status page: live availability of the dashboard, API and ingestion pipeline, measured by the checks the platform runs against itself.

legal.title: Legal Notice — Middle Monitor
legal.description: Legal notice for middlemonitor.io: who publishes and operates the Middle Monitor observability platform, how to contact us, and where the service is hosted.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy — Middle Monitor
privacy.description: How Middle Monitor handles your data: account and telemetry data, EU hosting, plan-based retention, subprocessors, security measures and your GDPR rights.

terms.title: Terms of Service — Middle Monitor
terms.description: Terms of service for the Middle Monitor observability platform: accounts, acceptable use, data ownership, plans and billing, availability and liability.

alternatives.title: Middle Monitor Alternatives — Compare Observability Tools
alternatives.description: How Middle Monitor compares to Datadog, Sentry, New Relic, Prometheus, Splunk, Nagios and Pingdom for tracing, error tracking, logs, infrastructure monitoring and uptime.

alt-datadog.title: Datadog Alternative — Middle Monitor Unified Observability
alt-datadog.description: Looking for a Datadog alternative? Middle Monitor correlates traces, metrics, logs and errors in one OpenTelemetry-native platform, with a free tier and self-serve pricing.

alt-sentry.title: Sentry Alternative — Error Tracking Correlated With Traces & Logs
alt-sentry.description: A Sentry alternative where error tracking sits alongside traces, metrics and logs. Full stacktraces, automatic panic and exception capture, and root cause correlation with your infrastructure.

alt-nagios.title: Nagios, Icinga & Zabbix Alternative — Monitoring Without Check Config
alt-nagios.description: A simpler alternative to Nagios, Icinga and Zabbix. System metrics collected automatically by a one-command agent, plus HTTP, ping, SQL, certificate and SNMP checks with built-in alerting.

alt-new-relic.title: New Relic & Dynatrace Alternative — Self-Serve APM
alt-new-relic.description: A New Relic and Dynatrace alternative for smaller engineering teams: distributed tracing, root cause analysis, continuous profiling and alerting on a self-serve platform.

alt-prometheus-grafana.title: Prometheus, Grafana & Jaeger Alternative — Managed OTLP Stack
alt-prometheus-grafana.description: A managed alternative to a self-hosted Prometheus, Grafana, Jaeger or Zipkin stack. OpenTelemetry-native ingestion with traces, metrics, logs and errors correlated in one place.

alt-splunk-elk.title: Splunk & ELK Alternative — Application Logs Without a Cluster
alt-splunk-elk.description: A Splunk and Elastic (ELK) alternative for application logs: collect logs through the same SDK as your traces and errors, in one observability platform, without operating a search cluster.

alt-pingdom-uptimerobot.title: Pingdom & UptimeRobot Alternative — Uptime Plus Full Observability
alt-pingdom-uptimerobot.description: A Pingdom, UptimeRobot and Better Stack alternative: HTTP, ping, SQL, certificate and SNMP checks with incident alerting, in the same platform as your traces, logs and errors.
